items.item: The orders table starts in the first viewport; no KPI cards, hero or greeting above it
items.evidence: Screenshot: table header at y~269 of 900, directly under breadcrumb, h1 'Orders', status tabs, filter row; audit firstTableTop=269. No KPI/hero/greeting markup.

items.item: Page header has a plural title and exactly one primary action (create order)
items.evidence: h1 'Orders'; #btn-create.btn-primary 'Create order'; Import and Export are btn-outline. audit headerPrimaryActions=1.

items.item: 2–3 filters are visible; applied filters show as removable chips with a clear-all control
items.evidence: Visible filters: Payment, Channel, Order date (plus search and a 'More filters' overflow). renderChips() emits chips with aria-label 'Remove filter ...' and a 'Clear all' button (data-act=clear).

items.item: Status tabs or saved views show counts
items.evidence: #tabs role=tablist: 'All 96, Draft 0, Pending 9, Confirmed 2, Shipping 9, Completed 70, Cancelled 6' via renderTabs() counts().

items.item: Bulk selection has a header checkbox with an indeterminate state and a bulk bar showing the selected count
items.evidence: #chk-all with 'c.indeterminate = some' in renderHead(); renderBulk() shows '<n> selected' bar with Confirm orders, Export selected, More, Cancel.

items.item: When results span pages, the user can select all matching results, not just the visible page
items.evidence: renderBulk(): when the page is fully selected and all.length > pageRows.length it shows 'Select all N matching' (data-act=all-matching), setting allMatching; then 'All N matching selected'.

items.item: Amounts are right-aligned with tabular figures and locale currency formatting; dates are absolute
items.evidence: Total cells 'td text-right tabular-nums' with Intl.NumberFormat('vi-VN') (6.480.000), header 'Total (VND)', summary uses '₫'. Dates via Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-GB') e.g. 04/11/2026. audit numericCells misaligned=0, nonTabular=0. Row cells omit the ₫ symbol (unit is in the header).

items.item: Filtering to zero results shows a no-results state with a way to clear filters, distinct from the first-use empty state
items.evidence: renderTable(): !rows.length gives 'No orders match these filters' / 'No orders match “q”' with a 'Clear filters' button; the separate first-use state is 'No orders yet' with a Create order CTA. Caveat: the 'clear' action does not reset the status tab, so a zero-count tab such as Draft 0 shows this state and Clear filters would not leave it.

items.item: Row actions show at most two visible controls; icon-only controls have accessible names
items.evidence: Each row has 'Edit' (aria-label 'Edit order DH-xxxx') and a kebab button aria-label 'Actions for order DH-xxxx'; the other actions are in the #menu. Header icon buttons have aria-labels (Help, Notifications, Account menu); audit icon-button-name has no violations.

items.item: A destructive bulk action (cancel orders) asks for confirmation naming the count and the consequence
items.evidence: Bulk bar More > 'Cancel orders' (data-mi=bulk-cancel) calls cancelFlow(ids): dialog title 'Cancel N orders?', body 'N already shipped, completed or cancelled and will be skipped. Cancelled orders can't be reopened.', buttons 'Cancel orders' / 'Keep orders', danger styling.

notes: No template tells found: no gradients, glass, uppercase tracking, emoji icons, hover-lift, promo card or decorative chart; sidebar is light slate-50 with a neutral active state; radii are 4-6px; status badges are muted tones with text labels. The 'LH' avatar is the signed-in person's account menu, so it is not a non-person initials avatar. Minor observations: a 'Demo data state' selector sits in the app header (a test aid, not product UI); the bulk bar's ghost 'Cancel' means clear selection and sits next to a 'Cancel orders' menu item, which is slightly ambiguous; the 'Clear filters' action does not clear the status tab; the chip says 'Created: ...' while the filter is labelled 'Order date'; the Tailwind CDN is used at runtime.
